params.body:
The home story block was titled "Drie generaties vakmanschap", and the history page's meta description repeated it. Nothing supports that: the history names two generations in the company (Ronny Schoutteet from 1970, Nancy from 1997, Heidi from 2012), and the current live site does not mention generations at all.

## What changes

- Home story block (built-in fallback): eyebrow "Ons verhaal", title "Sinds 1970 in Oudenburg", and a text that keeps to the history: a one-man business in 1970, today a company with its own workshop and a yard full of commercial vehicles, Nancy and Heidi Schoutteet by name, personal help with buying, selling and service.
- The same three strings in `lang/{en,fr,de,es}.json`, replacing the old keys.
- /geschiedenis meta description without "familiebedrijf" and without the generations line.

The live text of this block comes from Sanity (`homePage.story`), so the published document gets the same text in all five languages separately.

## Checked

- `php artisan test`: 56 passed; the built-in home test now asserts the new title and that "generaties" is gone.
- `vendor/bin/pint --test`: clean.
- No em dashes in the new copy.
params.title: Home story: no generations claim
